lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Gate's clear, count's stopped, and Ansel's in the chapel most evenings now people will come out after dark again.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Go and sit in the assembly. Nine people and a lamp. It's the only room in this century where somebody asks you what you think and then waits for the answer.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Snow's holding off. That's the whole of the news.
